mn2:0.2: The term _āsava_ is one of the more difficult Pāli technical terms to precisely translate into English. It refers to a category of harmful latent tendencies in the mind; impulses to engage in unwise attitudes and behaviors; subconscious influences that propel us towards unwholesome decisions. While a translation like “influence” would express part of this meaning and would also be linguistically related to the Pāli term, it lacks the distinctly negative moral connotation of _āsava_. The translation “vice” is an attempt to capture the specific meaning of a “harmful and addictive tendency.”
mn2:3.3: Or “mental activity” instead of “application of mind”
